messages:
jenna_support: fyi — escalated ticket from a heavy-usage customer. They see a ~23k token delta on the invoice vs dashboard for yesterday. Pattern: streaming chat with client reconnects/partial generations. Customer attached logs and a short repro.

alex_chen: can you drop the customer request_id + a minimal repro? also which model/endpoint were they hitting?

jenna_support: request_id=crm-req-20260311-9ab, model=gpt-rlhf-small, endpoint=/v1/chat/stream. repro steps below (client uses SSE and forcibly reconnects after partial chunk):

jenna_support: ```
# client pseudocode (node)
const ev = new EventSource(url, { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ...', 'X-Request-Id': 'crm-req-20260311-9ab' } });
ev.onmessage = (m) => { if (m.data === 'done') return; processChunk(m.data); if (Math.random() < 0.2) { ev.close(); // simulate midstream cancel/reconnect } }
```

jenna_support: attached raw server log excerpt:```
[03:12:41.123] stream:start id=crm-req-20260311-9ab
[03:12:41.456] sse:chunk id=chunk-1 tokens=402
[03:12:41.789] sse:client_disconnect id=crm-req-20260311-9ab code=1001
[03:12:42.001] sse:reconnect id=crm-req-20260311-9ab
[03:12:42.123] sse:chunk id=chunk-1 tokens=402
[03:12:42.456] render:done id=crm-req-20260311-9ab total_tokens=804
```

diego_sre: :eyes: that looks like identical chunk-id being processed twice. If the runtime increments metering on each chunk commit and we don't dedupe by (request_id, chunk_id) for reconnects, that would double-count. do we persist chunk ids anywhere?

priya_ml: runtime currently increments a token counter on each partial generation flush. There's an in-memory recent-chunk set but it lives per-worker instance. reconnects that route to a different worker could replay same chunk.

alex_chen: can billing_bot pull the invoice/day breakdown for that customer day? want to confirm 23k number and which route it came from.

billing_bot: invoice summary for customer acme-corp on 2026-03-11: billed_tokens=243,912; dashboard_total_tokens=220,584; delta=23,328. Top traffic window 03:10-03:20 UTC.

diego_sre: reproduced locally with a quick harness that reconnects to a different worker. local log shows:```
[local] meter.record(request=crm-req-20260311-9ab, chunk=chunk-1, tokens=402)
[local] client_disconnect request=crm-req-20260311-9ab
[local] reconnect -> routed to worker-2
[local] meter.record(request=crm-req-20260311-9ab, chunk=chunk-1, tokens=402)  # duplicate entry
```

diego_sre: hypothesis confirmed — duplicate meter entries when same chunk_id is replayed on different workers.

jenna_support: thanks diego. customer's on our paid tier, we should prioritize. I'll open an internal bug and notify infra.

jenna_support: repro ticket: INC-9876-billing-dup-chunk created and assigned to eng-runtime. steps, logs, customer impact attached. tagging @diego_sre @priya_ml

priya_ml: suggested short-term mitigation: treat identical (x-request-id, x-chunk-id) within a 60s window as idempotent at the metering layer (centralized dedupe store or publish to central event log before counting). long-term: attach chunk checksums to events so replays are safe.

alex_chen: can we also add a dashboard alert to surface sudden invoice vs dashboard delta > 5% for any customer day? that'll catch regressions earlier.

jenna_support: created a rollback-safe patch: runtime will first check central dedupe cache (redis) for (request_id, chunk_id) and skip counting if seen. PR opened: r/w-infer#4287.

diego_sre: merged hotfix to staging, running load test with reconnects. initial run shows no duplicate meter.record entries. tagging billing for verification.

billing_bot: will recon with accounting tomorrow and follow up if invoice adjustments needed.

jenna_support: thanks all — keeping customer updated with workaround and ETA for invoice review. moving thread to monitoring. :white_check_mark:
